node.title: Remaining raw-two ranks have source-preserving operator terminals of dimensions at most three
node.statement: For original KoalaBear rank12 sources J9965..21499, every over-budget actual P2 rank19..22 has a regularity-preserving weighted descent of8/9/10/11 anchors to regular pair/shared enclosures3/3,2/2,1/1,0/0. The exact factor is product_(j=1)^(r-11)(1048576+j)/(67472-t+j), t1/2. Dividing only pair differences gives original-field operator graph T on dimension c=22-r, retaining original labels and weights. Actual subsets need not span or fill the enclosure; nonsplit and nilpotent cases remain. c0 is a same-pair owner cap981104+t. No affordable c1/2/3 weights, rank19 payment, whole J, active atom or Prize closure.
